The merge of APP-1 stops on a conflict.

Work in the group folder <root>/.wt/app-1. Do not merge.
Rebase the branch of each repo on its base, fix the conflicts, and run the tests:
  app: rebase app-1 on main (conflicts: lib.go)
At the end, hand off for review:
  oversire review ready --key APP-1 --note "<one line>"
